title: Implement an offline JSONL request-log report CLI

criteria: node bin/report.js --input <file> --output <file> follows the README contract using only Node built-ins: empty lines ignored, malformed or invalid records counted as rejected, the first valid record kept for a duplicated id, services sorted by name with count, errors (status >= 500) and a nearest-rank p95 (ceil(0.95*n)), parent directories created, and a missing input failing with a nonzero exit without creating or overwriting the output. The data files, tests, README and package.json are untouched and the agent ran the tests.

review.description: A terminal task on local data: the fixture ships a CLI entry point, a stub summariser, a README contract and synthetic JSONL logs. The agent has to implement validation, first-wins de-duplication, per-service counts and a nearest-rank p95, and handle the output directory and the missing-input case without overwriting anything. No network and no keys are involved.
